pages.title: Begin with a Real Cache
pages.text: A Source Vein generates by its own rule, then commits into a persistent long-valued cache. Player extraction, face automation, and AE2 or RS storage buses all drain that cache. Simulation neither creates output nor prepays Immortal Yuan.

pages.title: Turn Sources into a Catalogue
pages.text: The Source Vein Manager may be placed only in its owner's Xianqiao. Its 72 slots each hold one vein and reject a duplicate name. It exposes a unified extraction-only catalogue while every member keeps producing, saving, and settling independently.

pages.title: Faces and Fluids
pages.text: Every face independently supports off, rate-limited push, or unlimited push. Face settings govern active export without hiding item or fluid capabilities. Fluid veins void fluid inserted through any face. Water and Lava veins can also serve as Create fan washing and blasting catalysts.

pages.title: Rendering Shows State
pages.text: Block and fluid sources render their real contents as smaller translucent cores rotating slowly about the geometric center. Item sources remain opaque, upright, centered, and rotate only around Y. Eight manager cores change in stages with its 72-slot occupancy, including inventory and held previews.

pages.title: For Pack Authors
pages.text: Datapacks and config may inject additional resources through the unified source-definition catalogue. One final definition is allowed per resource, preventing duplicate fees, cache, or statistics. External veins inherit the same cache, face, centered rendering, and manager aggregation rules.

pages.title: Immortal Yuan Boundary
pages.text: A paid vein settles only the shortfall that its real cache cannot cover. Existing Source Vein charging, prepayment, and conversion remain intact. Only the old non-source external-resource conversion was removed. Breaking a vein or manager preserves owner, cache, and face settings in complete block-entity data.

pages.title: Water and Milk
pages.text: These foundational fluid veins continuously provide Water and Milk, with the live fluid texture on every face of the floating core.

pages.title: Lava and Cobblestone
pages.text: Lava is exposed as extractable fluid; Cobblestone continues the basic-source chain into construction materials.

pages.title: Stone and Smooth Stone
pages.text: Smelt the Cobblestone vein into Stone, then Smooth Stone, keeping the material progression explicit.

pages.title: White and Orange Concrete
pages.text: Each concrete color keeps its own block identity and remains distinct when a manager checks duplicate names.

pages.title: Magenta and Light Blue Concrete
pages.text: Every color has its own recipe, cache, and catalogue entry.

pages.title: Yellow and Lime Concrete
pages.text: These veins are suited to sustained large-scale building supply.

pages.title: Pink and Gray Concrete
pages.text: Active export and external extraction both debit the real cache.

pages.title: Light Gray and Cyan Concrete
pages.text: Disabling active output keeps generated material safely in the vein cache.

pages.title: Purple and Blue Concrete
pages.text: A manager aggregates its members without copying their inventories.

pages.title: Brown and Green Concrete
pages.text: Standard storage buses can read the manager's aggregated view.

pages.title: Red and Black Concrete
pages.text: All sixteen colors are now covered and share one compatibility contract.

pages.title: Dirt and Oak Logs
pages.text: Common natural building materials can join the same continuous supply chain.

pages.title: Coal and Raw Copper
pages.text: Ore sources output their corresponding resources rather than fabricating ore-block states.

pages.title: Raw Iron and Raw Gold
pages.text: All three raw-metal veins can directly feed smelting and autocrafting.

pages.title: Lapis and Redstone
pages.text: Long-valued caches support sustained network extraction without 32-bit truncation.

pages.title: Crude Spirit Iron and Spirit Crystal
pages.text: These cultivation ores have independent definitions; their world generation follows Iron and Diamond ore respectively.

pages.title: Diamond and Emerald
pages.text: High-tier mineral veins retain the same real-cache and charging boundary.

pages.title: Echo Shards and Ancient Debris
pages.text: Rare-resource veins do not bypass progression or recipe cost; generated resources still enter cache first.

pages.title: Nether Stars and Enchanted Apples
pages.text: Expose these highest-tier veins through a manager, then use face settings to choose their destination.

pages.title: Dragon Egg Source
pages.text: The Dragon Egg vein closes the built-in chain. Like every item source, its core stays opaque, upright, centered, and rotates around Y.

pages.title: Complete Source Registry
pages.text: Crude Spirit Iron, Raw Copper, Raw Iron, and Raw Gold also have dedicated source blocks: immortalstorage:crude_spirit_iron_vein, immortalstorage:raw_copper_vein, immortalstorage:raw_iron_vein, and immortalstorage:raw_gold_vein. They follow the same supply, charging, cache, and manager rules in this chapter.
